_note: 2026 FRC Game Manual 里核实过的电气与保险杠规则要点（来自 https://www.frcmanual.com/2026/robot-construction-rules-(r) 的摘录，部分条文被截短；以官方手册全文为准）。2027 手册发布后必须重核。

battery.vents: must not be obstructed during charging
battery.secure: R606: must be secured so it will not dislodge during vigorous ROBOT interaction

main_power.devices: 1 battery, 1 pair Anderson SB connectors, 1 main 120A surface-mount breaker, 1 main power distribution device (PDP/PDP 2.0/PDH/AMPD)
main_power.breaker_access: R612: the 120A breaker must be quickly and safely accessible from the exterior of the ROBOT
main_power.visibility: R613: the PD, associated wiring and all circuit breakers must be visible for inspection
main_power.isolation: R611: all wiring and electrical devices electrically isolated from the ROBOT frame; the frame must not carry current
main_power.one_wire_per_terminal: R618: only 1 wire per PD terminal

breakers: R619: Snap Action VB3-A/AT2-A (F57), MX5-A/MX5-L up to 40A; REV or CTR ATO auto-resetting up to 40A; ATM breakers within R620 fuse limits
fuses: R620: PDP ATM per holder; all PDs ATC/ATO <= 10A; PDH ATM <= 15A plus one 20A for PCM/PH

control.rio_power: R615: directly from a non-switched protected pair of the PD
control.signal_light: R709: 1 or 2 diagnostic Robot Signal Lights (855PB-B12ME522 and/or am-3583)

bumpers.R402: padding >= 2.25 in deep, >= 4.5 in tall solid; backing >= 4.5 in tall; cloth cover; rigid fastening (no hook-and-loop, tape, cable ties)
bumpers.R405: padding+backing fill the BUMPER ZONE (2.5-5.75 in from floor)
bumpers.R406: corner joints filled with uncompressed padding extending >= 2.25 in
bumpers.R410: designed for installation and removal (inspection and weighing)
bumpers.R411: red or blue covers to show alliance
bumpers.R412: team number on the cover in >= 3 locations, white Arabic numerals >= 3.75 in high, >= 0.5 in stroke
